recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: a government vault breached in the night
coding agents getting their hours restored
overcast summer night holding San Francisco at fifteen degrees
a decades-old trial postponed at the threshold
late August quiet before the next ship

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Breached vault tiles slide down an overcast skyline — swipe shards into the correct containment lane before classified fragments spill over the edge.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each sealed leak triggers a satisfying lock-click cascade
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: new leak types appear and slide speed increases
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: fog-gray terminal with amber breach alerts

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Hold to charge a sunrise launch arc — release to ship a tiny agent payload across SF fog banks before the dawn deadline.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: a perfect sunrise landing unlocks a streak multiplier
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: wind shear and narrowing fog windows shrink the safe trajectory

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Parallel agent brains pulse on beat — tap the lane matching each planning phase as commit blocks stack toward a sunrise ship.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: a perfect streak makes side-by-side agents snap into sync visually
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: BPM climbs and active lanes swap mid-bar

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Broken word tiles drift across a grid — drag one unbroken path linking letter nodes into forbidden patterns before the board rejects you.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: completing a forbidden word dissolves the board in a glitch burst
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: decoy nodes multiply and the grid shrinks each round
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: newspaper cutout collage with redacted black bars
